insertValueMap.Digital D0..D1:
/* Arduino UNO/Nano D0..D1
 * D0 -> PD0 / RXD / PCINT16 / USART0 RX
 * D1 -> PD1 / TXD / PCINT17 / USART0 TX
 * Note: Serial and bootloader use these pins.
 */
insertValueMap.Digital D2..D3:
/* Arduino UNO/Nano D2..D3
 * D2 -> PD2 / INT0 / PCINT18
 * D3 -> PD3 / INT1 / OC2B / PWM / PCINT19
 */
insertValueMap.Digital D4..D7:
/* Arduino UNO/Nano D4..D7
 * D4 -> PD4 / T0 / PCINT20
 * D5 -> PD5 / OC0B / PWM / T1 / PCINT21
 * D6 -> PD6 / OC0A / PWM / AIN0 / PCINT22
 * D7 -> PD7 / AIN1 / PCINT23
 */
insertValueMap.Digital D8..D13:
/* Arduino UNO/Nano D8..D13
 * D8  -> PB0 / ICP1 / CLKO / PCINT0
 * D9  -> PB1 / OC1A / PWM / PCINT1
 * D10 -> PB2 / SS / OC1B / PWM / PCINT2
 * D11 -> PB3 / MOSI / OC2A / PWM / PCINT3
 * D12 -> PB4 / MISO / PCINT4
 * D13 -> PB5 / SCK / LED_BUILTIN / PCINT5
 */
insertValueMap.Analog A0..A5:
/* Arduino UNO/Nano analog header
 * A0/D14 -> PC0 / ADC0 / PCINT8
 * A1/D15 -> PC1 / ADC1 / PCINT9
 * A2/D16 -> PC2 / ADC2 / PCINT10
 * A3/D17 -> PC3 / ADC3 / PCINT11
 * A4/D18 -> PC4 / ADC4 / SDA / PCINT12
 * A5/D19 -> PC5 / ADC5 / SCL / PCINT13
 */
insertValueMap.I2C SDA/SCL:
/* Arduino UNO/Nano I2C / TWI
 * SDA -> A4 / PC4 / ADC4 / PCINT12
 * SCL -> A5 / PC5 / ADC5 / PCINT13
 * Enable with Wire.begin(); pull-ups are normally required on the bus.
 */
insertValueMap.SPI header:
/* Arduino UNO/Nano SPI
 * SS   -> D10 / PB2
 * MOSI -> D11 / PB3
 * MISO -> D12 / PB4
 * SCK  -> D13 / PB5
 * ICSP header exposes the same SPI bus and is preferred by shields.
 */
insertValueMap.PWM pins:
/* Arduino UNO/Nano PWM pins
 * Timer0: D5=OC0B, D6=OC0A. Also used by millis(), micros(), delay().
 * Timer1: D9=OC1A, D10=OC1B. 16-bit timer, often used by Servo-like libraries.
 * Timer2: D3=OC2B, D11=OC2A. Often used by tone() and timing libraries.
 */

insertValueMap.Timer0:
/* Timer0 — Arduino UNO/Nano
 * Registers: TCCR0A, TCCR0B, TCNT0, OCR0A, OCR0B, TIMSK0, TIFR0
 * PWM: D5=OC0B, D6=OC0A
 * Arduino core: millis(), micros(), delay() depend on Timer0.
 */
insertValueMap.Timer1:
/* Timer1 — Arduino UNO/Nano
 * Registers: TCCR1A, TCCR1B, TCCR1C, TCNT1, OCR1A, OCR1B, ICR1, TIMSK1, TIFR1
 * PWM: D9=OC1A, D10=OC1B; input capture: D8=ICP1
 */
insertValueMap.Timer2:
/* Timer2 — Arduino UNO/Nano
 * Registers: ASSR, TCCR2A, TCCR2B, TCNT2, OCR2A, OCR2B, TIMSK2, TIFR2
 * PWM: D3=OC2B, D11=OC2A
 */
insertValueMap.Pin-change interrupts:
/* Pin-change interrupts — Arduino UNO/Nano
 * PORTB PCINT0..7 -> PCMSK0 / PCINT0_vect
 * PORTC PCINT8..14 -> PCMSK1 / PCINT1_vect
 * PORTD PCINT16..23 -> PCMSK2 / PCINT2_vect
 */

insertValueMap.SREG:
/* SREG — Status Register
 * I: Global Interrupt Enable
 * T: Bit Copy Storage for BLD/BST
 * H: Half Carry Flag
 * S: Sign Flag = N XOR V
 * V: Two-complement Overflow Flag
 * N: Negative Flag
 * Z: Zero Flag
 * C: Carry Flag
 */
SREG = {{bits_SREG}};
insertValueMap.EICRA:
/* EICRA — External Interrupt Control Register A
 * ISC11: INT1 sense control bit 1
 * ISC10: INT1 sense control bit 0
 * ISC01: INT0 sense control bit 1
 * ISC00: INT0 sense control bit 0
 */
EICRA = {{bits_EICRA}};
insertValueMap.PCMSK0:
/* PCMSK0 — Pin Change Mask Register 0
 * PCINT0: Enable pin-change interrupt for PB0
 * PCINT1: Enable pin-change interrupt for PB1
 * PCINT2: Enable pin-change interrupt for PB2
 * PCINT3: Enable pin-change interrupt for PB3
 * PCINT4: Enable pin-change interrupt for PB4
 * PCINT5: Enable pin-change interrupt for PB5
 * PCINT6: Enable pin-change interrupt for PB6
 * PCINT7: Enable pin-change interrupt for PB7
 */
PCMSK0 = {{bits_PCMSK0}};
insertValueMap.PCMSK1:
/* PCMSK1 — Pin Change Mask Register 1
 * PCINT8: Enable pin-change interrupt for PC0
 * PCINT9: Enable pin-change interrupt for PC1
 * PCINT10: Enable pin-change interrupt for PC2
 * PCINT11: Enable pin-change interrupt for PC3
 * PCINT12: Enable pin-change interrupt for PC4
 * PCINT13: Enable pin-change interrupt for PC5
 * PCINT14: Enable pin-change interrupt for PC6
 */
PCMSK1 = {{bits_PCMSK1}};
insertValueMap.PCMSK2:
/* PCMSK2 — Pin Change Mask Register 2
 * PCINT16: Enable pin-change interrupt for PD0
 * PCINT17: Enable pin-change interrupt for PD1
 * PCINT18: Enable pin-change interrupt for PD2
 * PCINT19: Enable pin-change interrupt for PD3
 * PCINT20: Enable pin-change interrupt for PD4
 * PCINT21: Enable pin-change interrupt for PD5
 * PCINT22: Enable pin-change interrupt for PD6
 * PCINT23: Enable pin-change interrupt for PD7
 */
PCMSK2 = {{bits_PCMSK2}};
insertValueMap.DDRB:
/* DDRB — Port B Data Direction Register
 * DDB0: 1 = PB0 output, 0 = input
 * DDB1: 1 = PB1 output, 0 = input
 * DDB2: 1 = PB2 output, 0 = input
 * DDB3: 1 = PB3 output, 0 = input
 * DDB4: 1 = PB4 output, 0 = input
 * DDB5: 1 = PB5 output, 0 = input
 * DDB6: 1 = PB6 output, 0 = input

 * PORTB0: PB0 output level or input pull-up enable

 * PORTB2: PB2 output level or input pull-up enable
 * PORTB3: PB3 output level or input pull-up enable
 * PORTB4: PB4 output level or input pull-up enable
 * PORTB5: PB5 output level or input pull-up enable
 * PORTB6: PB6 output level or input pull-up enable

PIND = {{bits_PIND}};
insertValueMap.TCCR0A:
/* TCCR0A — Timer/Counter0 Control Register A
 * COM0A1: Compare Output Mode for channel A bit 1

 * CS11: Clock Select bit 1
 * CS10: Clock Select bit 0
 */
TCCR1B = {{bits_TCCR1B}};
insertValueMap.TIMSK1:
/* TIMSK1 — Timer/Counter1 Interrupt Mask Register

insertValueMap.SREG:
/* SREG — Status Register
 * I: Global Interrupt Enable
 * T: Bit Copy Storage for BLD/BST
 * H: Half Carry Flag
 * S: Sign Flag = N XOR V
 * V: Two-complement Overflow Flag
 * N: Negative Flag
 * Z: Zero Flag
 * C: Carry Flag
 */
SREG = {{bits_SREG}};
insertValueMap.MCUCR:
/* MCUCR — MCU Control Register
 * JTD: JTAG Interface Disable timed sequence bit
 * PUD: Pull-up Disable for all ports
 * IVSEL: Interrupt Vector Select; 1 = boot section vectors
 * IVCE: Interrupt Vector Change Enable timed sequence bit
 */
MCUCR = {{bits_MCUCR}};
insertValueMap.MCUSR:
/* MCUSR — MCU Status Register
 * JTRF: JTAG Reset Flag
 * WDRF: Watchdog Reset Flag
 * BORF: Brown-out Reset Flag
 * EXTRF: External Reset Flag
 * PORF: Power-on Reset Flag
 */
MCUSR = {{bits_MCUSR}};
insertValueMap.CLKPR:

 * CLKPS3: Clock Prescaler Select bit 3
 * CLKPS2: Clock Prescaler Select bit 2

 * CLKPS0: Clock Prescaler Select bit 0
 */
CLKPR = {{bits_CLKPR}};
insertValueMap.SMCR:
/* SMCR — Sleep Mode Control Register
 * SM2: Sleep Mode Select bit 2
 * SM1: Sleep Mode Select bit 1
 * SM0: Sleep Mode Select bit 0
 * SE: Sleep Enable
 */
SMCR = {{bits_SMCR}};
insertValueMap.PRR0:
/* PRR0 — Power Reduction Register 0
 * PRTWI: Power Reduction TWI
 * PRTIM2: Power Reduction Timer/Counter2
 * PRTIM0: Power Reduction Timer/Counter0

 * PRADC: Power Reduction ADC
 */
PRR0 = {{bits_PRR0}};

insertValueMap.WDTCSR:
/* WDTCSR — Watchdog Timer Control Register

 * SRE: External SRAM/XMEM Enable
 * SRL2: Wait-state sector limit bit 2
 * SRL1: Wait-state sector limit bit 1
 * SRL0: Wait-state sector limit bit 0
 * SRW11: Upper sector wait-state bit 1
 * SRW10: Upper sector wait-state bit 0
 * SRW01: Lower sector wait-state bit 1
 * SRW00: Lower sector wait-state bit 0
 */
XMCRA = {{bits_XMCRA}};
insertValueMap.XMCRB:
/* XMCRB — External Memory Control Register B
 * XMBK: External Memory Bus-keeper Enable
 * XMM2: External Memory High Mask bit 2
 * XMM1: External Memory High Mask bit 1
 * XMM0: External Memory High Mask bit 0
 */
XMCRB = {{bits_XMCRB}};

insertValueMap.ESP32 DevKit / WROOM:
/* ESP32 DevKit / WROOM reference
 * I2C common default: SDA GPIO21, SCL GPIO22
 * VSPI common default: SCK GPIO18, MISO GPIO19, MOSI GPIO23, SS GPIO5
 * UART0 USB bridge: GPIO1 TX0, GPIO3 RX0
 * Input-only pins: GPIO34..39
 * Avoid flash pins GPIO6..11; check strapping pins GPIO0, GPIO2, GPIO12, GPIO15.
 */
insertValueMap.ESP32-WROVER:
/* ESP32-WROVER reference
 * Similar to classic ESP32, but PSRAM is present.
 * Do not assume pins used by flash/PSRAM are available.
 * Verify module and board schematic before assigning GPIO16/GPIO17 or high-numbered pins.
 */
insertValueMap.ESP32-S2:
/* ESP32-S2 reference
 * Native USB device/host capability depending board routing.
 * No Bluetooth.
 * GPIO matrix is flexible but strapping and USB pins must be respected.
 */
insertValueMap.ESP32-S3:
/* ESP32-S3 reference
 * Native USB is common; some boards expose USB CDC by default.
 * Pin availability depends strongly on module flash/PSRAM package.
 * Prefer board definitions and schematic before hardcoding SPI/I2C pins.
 */
insertValueMap.ESP32-C3:
/* ESP32-C3 reference
 * RISC-V core, Wi-Fi/BLE, compact GPIO set.
 * USB Serial/JTAG may occupy dedicated pins on some boards.
 * Default pin aliases differ from classic ESP32 boards.
 */
insertValueMap.ESP32-C6:
/* ESP32-C6 reference
 * RISC-V with newer radio features depending module.
 * GPIO capabilities and strapping pins are board-specific.
 * Always verify selected Arduino board package and schematic.
 */

insertValueMap.General safe GPIO:
/* ESP32 GPIO selection
 * Prefer board-defined pins and schematic-safe GPIOs.
 * Avoid flash, USB, strapping and PSRAM pins unless the board documentation allows them.
 */
insertValueMap.Input-only GPIO34..39:
/* Classic ESP32 input-only GPIO
 * GPIO34, GPIO35, GPIO36, GPIO39 are input-only.
 * No output drive; internal pull-up/down support is limited.
 */
insertValueMap.Strapping pins:
/* ESP32 strapping pins
 * Common classic ESP32 strapping pins include GPIO0, GPIO2, GPIO4, GPIO5, GPIO12, GPIO15.
 * External pull states affect boot mode and flash voltage selection.
 */
insertValueMap.Flash pins GPIO6..11:
/* ESP32 flash pins
 * GPIO6..GPIO11 are commonly connected to module SPI flash.
 * Do not use them as application GPIO on typical WROOM/WROVER boards.
 */
insertValueMap.ADC1:
/* ESP32 ADC1
 * Classic ESP32 ADC1 channels are generally preferred for analog reads while Wi-Fi is active.
 * Calibrate and account for non-linearity for measurement work.
 */
insertValueMap.ADC2 Wi-Fi caveat:
/* ESP32 ADC2 caveat
 * On classic ESP32, ADC2 is shared with the Wi-Fi subsystem.
 * Prefer ADC1 pins for analogRead() in Wi-Fi applications.
 */
insertValueMap.DAC pins:
/* ESP32 DAC pins
 * Classic ESP32: DAC1 GPIO25, DAC2 GPIO26.
 * Not all ESP32 families provide DAC outputs.
 */
insertValueMap.Touch pins:
/* ESP32 touch pins
 * Capacitive touch support depends on ESP32 family.
 * Use touchRead(pin) only on touch-capable pins for the selected board.
 */

insertValueMap.Raspberry Pi 1 Model A/B 26-pin:
/* Raspberry Pi 1 Model A/B — 26-pin header
 * Older header layout. Verify pinout before reusing 40-pin HAT diagrams.
 * Prefer BCM GPIO numbering in software and document physical pin numbers separately.
 */
insertValueMap.Raspberry Pi 1 Model B+ / A+ 40-pin:
/* Raspberry Pi 1 B+ / A+ — 40-pin header
 * HAT-style 40-pin header introduced.
 * Common roles: I2C1 pins 3/5, SPI0 pins 19/21/23/24/26, UART pins 8/10.
 */
insertValueMap.Raspberry Pi 2 40-pin:
/* Raspberry Pi 2 — 40-pin header
 * Standard 40-pin mapping. Use libgpiod character devices on modern Linux.
 * Enable interfaces with raspi-config or /boot/firmware/config.txt overlays.
 */
insertValueMap.Raspberry Pi 3 40-pin:
/* Raspberry Pi 3 — 40-pin header
 * Standard 40-pin mapping.
 * Bluetooth can change primary UART assignment; check /dev/serial0 and overlays.
 */
insertValueMap.Raspberry Pi 4 40-pin:
/* Raspberry Pi 4 — 40-pin header
 * Standard 40-pin mapping with richer overlay options.
 * Use /dev/gpiochip*, /dev/i2c-*, /dev/spidev* and /dev/serial0 rather than direct SoC registers.
 */
insertValueMap.Raspberry Pi 5 40-pin:
/* Raspberry Pi 5 — 40-pin header
 * Header concept remains, but low-level GPIO controller details changed.
 * Prefer libgpiod/pinctrl tools and Raspberry Pi OS abstractions.
 */
insertValueMap.Raspberry Pi Zero / Zero 2 W:
/* Raspberry Pi Zero / Zero 2 W — small form factor
 * 40-pin-compatible header footprint, often unpopulated.
 * Electrical and software mapping follows the 40-pin Raspberry Pi conventions.
 */
insertValueMap.Raspberry Pi Pico / RP2040 note:
/* Raspberry Pi Pico / RP2040 note
 * This is a microcontroller board, not a Linux Raspberry Pi SBC.
 * Use RP2040 GPIO numbering, PIO, ADC and the Pico SDK / Arduino-Pico / MicroPython pack style.
 */

functions.insertText:
[Unit]
Description=Robot controller
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/opt/robot-controller
ExecStart=/opt/robot-controller/bin/controller
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
User=robot

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
